**The design is now fixed and all tests pass.**

The bug was on line 38 of `mult_seq.v`: the condition for accepting a new multiplication should be `if (start && !busy)` instead of just `if (start)`. This ensures that start signals arriving while a multiplication is in progress are ignored (as per Rule 2 of the spec), preventing the interruption of ongoing operations.
